name: Samantha
source: Originally from the UK, although many cafe visitors are confused about this fact. Samantha is simply a fan of Japanese cuisine, and came to the country to develop her skills. She ended up in a cafe, and now she "manages" it because there are no other employees. She is kind, cunning and often likes to tease man.
